source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: MCE P8-4 to P9-1 pre-check
steps.body: Access machine control electronics. Measure resistance across P8-4 and P9-1. If 1–6 Ω, replace MCE. Otherwise continue to belt switch and motor at component.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access machine control electronics. Measure resistance across P8-4 and P9-1. If 1–6 Ω, replace MCE. Otherwise continue to belt switch and motor at component.

steps.title: Access belt switch and motor
steps.body: Remove back panel. Release drum belt from belt switch pulley. Disconnect white connector from drive motor switch.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove back panel. Release drum belt from belt switch pulley. Disconnect white connector from drive motor switch.

steps.title: Main winding — pin 4 to pin 5
steps.body: At motor switch: measure main winding between lt. blue wire at pin 4 and bare copper at pin 5. Spec 2.4–3.6 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At motor switch: measure main winding between lt. blue wire at pin 4 and bare copper at pin 5. Spec 2.4–3.6 Ω.

branches.label: Out of spec
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive motor — main winding out of spec.

branches.label: Borderline / warning
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive motor — main winding out of spec.

branches.label: Open circuit
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive motor — main winding out of spec.

steps.title: Start winding — pin 4 to pin 3
steps.body: At motor switch: measure start winding between lt. blue at pin 4 and bare copper at pin 3. Spec 2.4–3.8 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At motor switch: measure start winding between lt. blue at pin 4 and bare copper at pin 3. Spec 2.4–3.8 Ω.

branches.label: Out of spec
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive motor — start winding out of spec.

branches.label: Borderline / warning
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive motor — start winding out of spec.

branches.label: Open circuit
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive motor — start winding out of spec.

steps.title: Belt switch — infinity down, few Ω up
steps.body: With belt off pulley, belt switch should read infinity (OL). Push pulley up — should read a few ohms. Door switch with door closed: 0–2 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With belt off pulley, belt switch should read infinity (OL). Push pulley up — should read a few ohms. Door switch with door closed: 0–2 Ω.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace belt switch or door switch per failed check.

steps.title: Service belt/door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace failed belt switch or door switch.

steps.title: Motor circuit verified at component
steps.oemOutcome: Motor windings and belt/door switches OK — inspect harness to MCE if F-26 persists.
